questions.question: What changes after an HTTP WebSocket upgrade succeeds?
options: The connection becomes a long-lived framed full-duplex channel over the underlying transport
Every message becomes an HTTP request
The server no longer needs authorization
TCP message boundaries become application messages
questions.explanation: WebSocket supplies frames and bidirectional exchange, while the application still owns message and security semantics.

questions.question: Why can a gateway fit all connections but still fail?
options: A broadcast or hot room can amplify a small inbound rate into excessive outbound sends, queues, CPU, or bandwidth
questions.explanation: Connection capacity and message/fan-out capacity are separate resource envelopes.

questions.question: What should happen when a per-client send queue reaches its limit?
options: Apply a declared policy such as coalesce, drop replaceable events, disconnect, or force resync
questions.explanation: Backpressure must be bounded and preserve application semantics.

questions.question: Why are ping/pong and application acknowledgement different?
options: Ping/pong shows transport liveness; an application acknowledgement proves processing under the message protocol
questions.explanation: A live connection does not prove a business message was validated or committed.

questions.question: What prevents a rolling deployment from causing a reconnect storm?
options: Connection draining, warm replacement capacity, exponential backoff, jitter, retry hints, and staged rollout
questions.explanation: Admission must absorb reconnect traffic without synchronizing the whole client fleet.

questions.question: When is a durable resume cursor useful?
options: When retained ordered events can replay after the last acknowledged sequence and gaps must be detected
When every client may read every tenant
questions.explanation: The cursor connects client progress to a replayable event boundary.

questions.question: Which checks belong at the WebSocket handshake?
options: TLS, origin where relevant, authentication, subprotocol, version, quotas, and admission policy
Message deduplication for future events only
questions.explanation: The handshake establishes connection identity and capability before long-lived resources are assigned.

questions.question: What should a client do when its resume cursor has expired from retention?
options: Fetch a current authoritative snapshot, bind its version, then subscribe to later events
Append live events to stale state without checking
questions.explanation: Snapshot plus versioned subscription restores a coherent boundary after replay is no longer possible.
